title.narrative: Support to improve sustainability of the electricity service

description.narrative: The general objective of the Project is to contribute to the sustainability of the power sector by strengthening the operational procedures and corporate performance of Energiebedrijven Suriname, National Electricity Company (EBS), and by improving the sustainability of rural electricity supply. Therefore the main target of the project is to provide reliable electricity access based on Renewable Energy Technologies (RET) to specific rural communities in the Hinterlands.
